profile.name: Sakthi Sudharsini S
profile.title: Software Engineer | Generative AI | LLM Applications | Python
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience in Python, application development, Generative AI, and backend systems. Experienced in building LLM-based applications using FastAPI and Groq API, with capabilities including conversational memory, streaming, document processing, multimodal AI, and model integration. Also experienced in developing computer vision solutions for mobile applications, including face detection, face embeddings, identity verification, and API-based integration.

responsibilities: Developed 50+ responsive web pages across education, sports, food, landing-page, and business domains using Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
Built reusable frontend components and collaborated with developers and clients to deliver responsive web applications across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Built a Python-based face verification service for a native mobile employee attendance application, integrating AI-based identity verification into the check-in/check-out workflow.

Enrollment and verification APIs with image quality checks
